assumptions: Requests, route events, tonnage, inspections, dumping evidence, contamination, and completion remain distinct.

constraints.description: The sanitation, waste, and street cleanliness forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: sanitation commissioner and waste operations chief
decision_question: What route-time volume, contamination, cleaning, and exception workload should operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The sanitation, waste, and street cleanliness forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for waste collection and street-cleaning workload passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: seasonal route, land-use, and event-conditioned forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: service workload above route and facility capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting waste collection and street-cleaning workload, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: service workload above route and facility capacity
distributional gap in service workload above route and facility capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present forecast workload as observed tonnage, dumping, contamination, or missed service.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for waste collection and street-cleaning workload passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast waste, recycling, and cleaning workload
transportability_risks: Collection systems, housing form, waste law, contracts, markets, and reporting behavior differ.
Request labels and tonnage do not fully capture cleanliness or illegal dumping.
